items.headline: AI rally wobbles as investors turn attention to earnings
items.summary: Reuters reported that AI-linked shares, including semiconductor and technology-hardware stocks, weakened as investors prepared to judge whether hyperscaler earnings and capital spending can support the rally.

items.headline: US markets weighed down by extended technology-sector sell-off
items.summary: The Associated Press reported that weakness in AI stocks was a major drag on technology-heavy indexes during the week’s sell-off.

items.headline: AI stocks remain under pressure as investors assess spending and debt risks
items.summary: TheStreet reported that CoreWeave’s decline intensified doubts about whether future AI revenue can keep pace with infrastructure spending, while Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang played down the concerns.

items.headline: Motley Fool strategist discusses which AI stocks may withstand correction
items.summary: Bill Mann argued that investors should weigh technological importance against balance-sheet risk, expressing greater confidence in foundational AI companies than in highly leveraged businesses.
